resources.string: Samsung Classic DeX & Dual Workstation Engine
Classic Samsung DeX style active (Slim taskbar, 3-button nav, Quick popups, PC window controls)
Stock Xiaomi HyperOS Workstation Mode active (Floating dock, gesture navigation, standard pill)
Expand dock to 100% screen width and eliminate floating pills
Anchor app drawer button to bottom-left with DeX grid icon
Display authentic Recents [ ||| ], Home [ ◯ ], and Back [ < ] buttons on far-left
Display dedicated Search [ Q ] button next to navigation controls
Show compact Samsung DeX Quick Settings & Notification popups above tray instead of full screen
Display Minimize [ — ], Maximize [ □ ], and Close [ ✕ ] in window titlebars
Display application name and icon on the left of window caption
HyperOS Workstation Mode: INACTIVE (Normal Tablet Mode)
When Workstation Mode is turned on in Control Center, HyperDeX automatically presents Samsung Classic DeX. When turned off, the stock tablet launcher is preserved.
Keep the edge-to-edge DeX taskbar active even in standard tablet launcher

Taskbar settings reset to Samsung DeX defaults!
